# sc_01_qc.R
# Task 1: Quality control of the scRNA-seq .h5ad dataset
# Reads the file with zellkonverter (pure-R reader, matrix stays on disk),
# explores its structure, computes per-cell QC metrics, filters low-quality
# cells, and saves the filtered SCE for downstream scripts.

```{r}
# sc_00_setup.R
# Package installation and shared configuration for scRNA-seq EGFR analysis
# Source this file at the top of every analysis script.

# ── 1. Package installation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

bioc_pkgs <- c(
  "zellkonverter",        # read .h5ad with pure-R reader (no Python needed)
  "SingleCellExperiment",
  "scuttle",              # per-cell QC metrics
  "scran",                # normalization, highly variable genes
  "scater",               # QC plots, dimension reduction wrappers
  "HDF5Array",            # on-disk matrix backend (keeps 17 GB off RAM)
  "rhdf5",                # low-level HDF5 inspection
  "BiocParallel",
  "org.Hs.eg.db",         # Ensembl ID → gene symbol mapping
  "AnnotationDbi"
)


install_if_missing <- function(pkgs, installer) {
  missing <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% rownames(installed.packages())]
  if (length(missing)) {
    message("Installing: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
    installer(missing)
  }
}

install_if_missing(bioc_pkgs, BiocManager::install)

```

# read sce data

```{r}

listing <- h5ls(H5AD_FILE, recursive = TRUE)
obs_children <- listing[listing$group == "/obs", ]
print(obs_children)

group_cols <- obs_children$name[obs_children$otype == "H5I_GROUP"]
cat("Columns stored as nested HDF5 groups (likely categoricals):\n")
print(group_cols)

h5closeAll()

decode_group_column <- function(file, group, col) {
  path <- paste0(group, "/", col)
  x <- rhdf5::h5read(file, path)
  if (!is.list(x)) return(x)

  nm <- names(x)
  if (!is.null(nm) && all(c("codes", "categories") %in% nm)) {
    ## BUG (found 2026-08): using 0 as the "missing" index is wrong. R
    ## drops zero-valued subscripts from the result instead of inserting
    ## NA at that position, so `cats[codes + 1L]` SHRINKS whenever any
    ## code is -1 (missing) -- the output ends up shorter than `codes`,
    ## and the later `out[codes < 0] <- NA` then extends/recycles that
    ## shortened, already-misaligned vector against the full-length
    ## `codes < 0` mask. Net effect: not just the missing entries end up
    ## wrong -- valid "mutated"/"not mutated" calls get shifted onto the
    ## wrong cells and often overwritten with NA too. Confirmed by
    ## reproducing it directly: codes = c(-1,0,1,-1,0,1,1) should decode to
    ## NA,mutated,not-mutated,NA,mutated,not-mutated,not-mutated, but the
    ## old code above produced NA,not-mutated,mutated,NA,not-mutated,NA,NA.
    ##
    ## Fix: use NA_integer_ (not 0) as the missing index. `vec[NA]` is NA
    ## and preserves length; `vec[0]` drops the position and shrinks it.
    codes <- as.integer(x$codes)
    cats  <- as.character(x$categories)
    idx <- codes + 1L
    idx[codes < 0] <- NA_integer_
    out <- factor(cats[idx], levels = unique(cats))
    return(out)
  }
  if (!is.null(nm) && all(c("values", "mask") %in% nm)) {
    # pandas nullable Int64/boolean/Float64 extension array
    vals <- x$values
    mask <- as.logical(x$mask)   # TRUE = missing, per anndata's convention
    vals[mask] <- NA
    return(vals)
  }

  stop(sprintf("unrecognized nested structure (inner names: %s)",
               paste(nm, collapse = ", ")))
}

# kept for compatibility with earlier calls in this file/your session
decode_obs_column <- function(file, col) decode_group_column(file, "/obs", col)

rebuild_group_dataframe <- function(file, group) {
  listing <- rhdf5::h5ls(file, recursive = TRUE)
  children <- listing[listing$group == group, ]
  cols <- unique(children$name[children$otype %in% c("H5I_GROUP", "H5I_DATASET")])
  cols <- setdiff(cols, c("_index", "__categories"))

  col_list <- list()
  for (cn in cols) {
    val <- tryCatch(
      decode_group_column(file, group, cn),
      error = function(e) {
        message(sprintf("SKIPPING %s column '%s': %s", group, cn, conditionMessage(e)))
        NULL
      }
    )
    if (!is.null(val)) col_list[[cn]] <- val
  }

  # figure out the row index (cell barcodes for /obs, gene ids for /var)
  idx_attr <- tryCatch(
    rhdf5::h5readAttributes(file, group)[["_index"]],
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  idx_name <- if (!is.null(idx_attr)) idx_attr else "_index"
  row_ids <- as.character(rhdf5::h5read(file, paste0(group, "/", idx_name)))

  # do.call splices col_list into separate ... arguments -- equivalent to
  # DataFrame(col_list, ...) for a bare named list, but written explicitly
  # here since col_list may legitimately be shorter than the full column set
  # after skipping bad columns.
  df <- do.call(S4Vectors::DataFrame, c(col_list, list(row.names = row_ids)))
  rhdf5::h5closeAll()
  df
}

rebuild_obs_dataframe <- function(file) rebuild_group_dataframe(file, "/obs")
rebuild_var_dataframe <- function(file) rebuild_group_dataframe(file, "/var")

sce <- zellkonverter::readH5AD(H5AD_FILE, reader = "R", use_hdf5 = TRUE)  # colData empty, warning as before

x <- assay(sce, assayNames(sce)[1])
class(x)
dim(x)
DelayedArray::seed(x)          # shows the actual backing chain zellkonverter built

# does a SMALL slice work, or does even this fail?
tryCatch(print(x[1:5, 1:5]), error = function(e) print(e))


obs_df <- rebuild_obs_dataframe(H5AD_FILE)


## ALIGNING obs_df with sce when colnames(sce) is NULL
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Because the original colData assignment threw inside zellkonverter's own
## tryCatch, it never got to the point of copying obs's index into
## colnames(sce) either -- that's *why* colnames(sce) is NULL, not evidence
## that the assay columns are unordered or scrambled. The assay-loading path
## (which did succeed) is untouched by any of this: it just reads /X's row
## dimension off disk in on-disk order.
##
## The anndata/h5ad format guarantees index-alignment between X and obs by
## construction: X.shape[0] == len(obs), and row i of X *is* obs row i --
## that's what "obs indexes X" means in the format. Reading /X and reading
## /obs both walk the file in raw on-disk order with no sorting/filtering in
## either our decode code or zellkonverter's assay loader, and going from
## AnnData's (n_obs, n_vars) layout to SCE's (n_vars, n_obs) is a transpose
## (a dimension swap), not a permutation -- column j after transposing is
## still exactly row j before. So obs_df's row order and sce's column order
## are already the same order; there's nothing to "match up" by name because
## colnames(sce) doesn't exist yet for either side to match against. Don't
## try to reindex obs_df by colnames(sce) (that will just error/empty out
## since colnames(sce) is NULL) -- assign directly, in this shared order:

stopifnot(nrow(obs_df) == ncol(sce))   # sanity check on count, not order

colnames(sce) <- rownames(obs_df)      # the cell barcodes decoded from /obs/_index
colData(sce)  <- obs_df

# rebuild rowData

var_df <- rebuild_var_dataframe(H5AD_FILE)

stopifnot(nrow(var_df) == nrow(sce))   # count check, not order

## Same alignment argument as colData, mirrored onto the other dimension:
## /var indexes the SECOND dimension of X (X.shape == (n_obs, n_vars)), which
## after the obs-x-vars -> vars-x-obs transpose becomes the FIRST dimension
## of the SCE assay -- i.e. row i of var *is* row i of the assay, by the same
## on-disk-order + transpose-not-permutation reasoning as before. Assign
## directly; there's no rownames(sce) yet to reindex against:

rownames(sce) <- rownames(var_df)   # gene ids decoded from /var/_index
rowData(sce)  <- var_df

## And the same "don't just trust it" check, mirrored onto genes: recompute
## a per-gene QC statistic scanpy commonly stores in var (e.g. n_cells with
## nonzero counts, or mean expression) from the assay itself, for a random
## subsample of genes, and compare:

colnames(var_df)  # see what QC columns are actually available in your file
qc_col <- "n_cells_by_counts"   # substitute whatever numeric QC column your var has

if (qc_col %in% colnames(var_df)) {
  set.seed(1)
  chk <- sample(nrow(sce), min(2000, nrow(sce)))
  recomputed <- Matrix::rowSums(assay(sce, assayNames(sce)[1])[chk, , drop = FALSE] > 0)
  reported   <- var_df[[qc_col]][chk]
  cat("correlation:", cor(recomputed, reported), "\n")
  cat("max abs diff:", max(abs(recomputed - reported)), "\n")
}

# ── 2. Filter relevant studies from atlas ─────────────────────────────────────
## EGFR data sets:
# He_Fan -> only EGFR mutated
# Wo_Zhou -> do not provide patient metadata -> cannot identify EGFR mutated patients
# Kim_Lee_2020 -> no metadata available

unique(sce$cell_type)
table(sce$study, sce$EGFR_mutation)
study_keep <- c("He_Fan_2021","Wu_Zhou_2021", "Kim_Lee_2020","Maynard_Bivona_2020","Chen_Zhang_2020",
                "Lambrechts_Thienpont_2018","Zilionis_Klein_2019","Laughney_Massague_2020")
sce <- sce[,sce$study %in% study_keep]
```

# assay structure - to be deleted

```{r}

# ── 3. Characterise the available assays ──────────────────────────────────────
# The dataset contains three assays whose nature we need to establish before
# choosing one for QC and downstream scoring:
#   "count"                — expected to be raw integer counts
#   "X"                    — unknown (could be normalised, log-normalised, etc.)
#   "counts_length_scaled" — likely length-scaled counts (à la tximeta/fishpond)

message("\n=== Characterising assay slots ===")
cat("Assay names present:", paste(assayNames(sce), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

inspect_assay <- function(sce, aname, n_cells = 500, n_genes = 200) {
  mat <- as.matrix(assay(sce[seq_len(min(n_genes, nrow(sce))),
                              sample(ncol(sce), min(n_cells, ncol(sce)))],
                         aname))
  all_int  <- all(mat == floor(mat), na.rm = TRUE)
  max_val  <- max(mat,  na.rm = TRUE)
  min_val  <- min(mat,  na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_val <- mean(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
  sparsity <- mean(mat == 0, na.rm = TRUE)

  type_guess <- if (all_int && max_val > 50)  "raw integer counts" else
                if (all_int && max_val <= 50)  "raw counts (low depth or subset)" else
                if (!all_int && max_val > 50)  "length-scaled / TPM (not log-transformed)" else
                if (!all_int && max_val <= 20) "likely log-normalised" else
                                               "normalised (unlogged)"

  cat(sprintf(
    "  %-25s  min=%.2f  max=%.2f  mean=%.3f  sparsity=%.1f%%  all_integer=%-5s  => %s\n",
    aname, min_val, max_val, mean_val, 100 * sparsity, all_int, type_guess
  ))
  invisible(list(all_int = all_int, max_val = max_val, type = type_guess))
}

assay_info <- setNames(
  lapply(assayNames(sce), inspect_assay, sce = sce),
  assayNames(sce)
)

cat("\nConclusion:\n")
cat("  'count'                — used for QC (assay.type='count') and as raw counts\n")
cat("  'counts_length_scaled' — salmon/tximeta length-scaled estimates; not log-transformed\n")
cat("  'X'                    — inspect max value above to confirm nature;\n")
cat("                           if max <= 20 it is log-normalised and suitable for scoring;\n")
cat("                           if max > 50  it is a (possibly size-factor-scaled) raw matrix\n")

# Save assay summary
assay_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(assay_info), function(nm) {
  ai <- assay_info[[nm]]
  data.frame(assay = nm, all_integer = ai$all_int,
             max_value = ai$max_val, type_guess = ai$type,
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
write.csv(assay_summary, file.path(OUT_DIR, "assay_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
message("Saved: assay_summary.csv")

```

# QC
```{r}
# Identify mitochondrial genes (MT- prefix for human)
mt_genes <- grepl("^MT-", rownames(sce), ignore.case = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Mitochondrial genes detected: %d\n", sum(mt_genes)))

# If MT genes not found by prefix, try gene_name column in rowData
if (sum(mt_genes) == 0 && "gene_name" %in% names(rowData(sce))) {
  mt_genes <- grepl("^MT-", rowData(sce)$gene_name, ignore.case = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("Mitochondrial genes (via gene_name): %d\n", sum(mt_genes)))
}


qc_metrics <- scuttle::perCellQCMetrics(
  sce,
  assay.type = "count",
  subsets = list(Mito = which(mt_genes)),
  BPPARAM = bpparam()
)

# Add metrics to colData
colData(sce) <- cbind(colData(sce), qc_metrics)

cat("\nQC metric summaries:\n")
print(summary(qc_metrics$sum))           # total UMI
print(summary(qc_metrics$detected))      # genes detected
print(summary(qc_metrics$subsets_Mito_percent))  # % mitochondrial

# ── 5. Determine adaptive QC thresholds ───────────────────────────────────────
# Adaptive thresholds based on MAD (median absolute deviation) are robust
# to differences between samples / batches.

# Determine batch variable (use sample/patient column if present)
cd_now <- as.data.frame(colData(sce))
batch_col <- NULL
for (candidate in c("sample", "sample_id", "patient", "donor", "batch", "orig.ident")) {
  if (candidate %in% names(cd_now)) {
    batch_col <- candidate
    break
  }
}
cat(sprintf("\nBatch variable for adaptive QC: %s\n",
            ifelse(is.null(batch_col), "none (global thresholds)", batch_col)))

qc_filters <- scuttle::perCellQCFilters(
  qc_metrics,
  sub.fields = "subsets_Mito_percent",
  batch = if (!is.null(batch_col)) cd_now[[batch_col]] else NULL
)

cat("\nCells failing each filter:\n")
print(colSums(as.data.frame(qc_filters)))
cat(sprintf("Total cells to remove: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            sum(qc_filters$discard),
            ncol(sce),
            100 * mean(qc_filters$discard)))

# ── 6. QC plots ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

message("\n=== Generating QC plots ===")

qc_df <- data.frame(
  nUMI      = qc_metrics$sum,
  nGenes    = qc_metrics$detected,
  pct_mito  = qc_metrics$subsets_Mito_percent,
  discard   = qc_filters$discard,
  batch     = if (!is.null(batch_col)) cd_now[[batch_col]] else "all"
)

# Violin plots per batch
p_umi <- ggplot(qc_df, aes(x = batch, y = log10(nUMI + 1), fill = discard)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#4393c3", "TRUE" = "#d6604d")) +
  labs(title = "Total UMI (log10)", x = NULL, y = "log10(UMI + 1)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p_genes <- ggplot(qc_df, aes(x = batch, y = log10(nGenes + 1), fill = discard)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#4393c3", "TRUE" = "#d6604d")) +
  labs(title = "Genes detected (log10)", x = NULL, y = "log10(genes + 1)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p_mito <- ggplot(qc_df, aes(x = batch, y = pct_mito, fill = discard)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 20, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#4393c3", "TRUE" = "#d6604d")) +
  labs(title = "% Mitochondrial reads", x = NULL, y = "% MT") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Scatter: nUMI vs nGenes, coloured by discard
p_scatter <- ggplot(qc_df, aes(x = log10(nUMI + 1), y = log10(nGenes + 1),
                                colour = discard, alpha = discard)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#4393c3", "TRUE" = "#d6604d")) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values  = c("FALSE" = 0.2, "TRUE" = 0.8)) +
  labs(title = "UMI vs Genes", x = "log10(UMI + 1)", y = "log10(genes + 1)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10)

p_scatter_mito <- ggplot(qc_df, aes(x = log10(nUMI + 1), y = pct_mito,
                                     colour = discard, alpha = discard)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#4393c3", "TRUE" = "#d6604d")) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values  = c("FALSE" = 0.2, "TRUE" = 0.8)) +
  labs(title = "UMI vs % Mito", x = "log10(UMI + 1)", y = "% MT") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10)

qc_plot <- (p_umi | p_genes | p_mito) / (p_scatter | p_scatter_mito) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Per-cell QC metrics",
                  subtitle = sprintf("%d cells before filtering", ncol(sce)))

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "qc_metrics.png"), qc_plot,
       width = 14, height = 9, dpi = 150)
message("Saved: qc_metrics.png")

# ── 7. Filter and save ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

sce <- sce[, !qc_filters$discard]
message(sprintf("\nCells after QC: %d (removed %d)", ncol(sce),
                sum(qc_filters$discard)))

# Save per-sample QC summary
if (!is.null(batch_col)) {
  qc_summary <- qc_df %>%
    group_by(batch) %>%
    summarise(
      total_cells    = n(),
      kept_cells     = sum(!discard),
      removed_cells  = sum(discard),
      pct_removed    = round(100 * mean(discard), 1),
      median_UMI     = round(median(nUMI[!discard])),
      median_genes   = round(median(nGenes[!discard])),
      median_pct_mt  = round(median(pct_mito[!discard]), 1),
      .groups        = "drop"
    )
  write.csv(qc_summary, file.path(OUT_DIR, "qc_per_sample_summary.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  print(qc_summary)
}

# select relevant studies and patient populations -

# Wu_Zhou: patients that are LUAD and mutated. of these 9 are EGFR. maybe we can find out
wu_zhou_mutated <- c("P38","P24","P13","P20","P33","P16","P8" ,"P28","P2","P34","P9","P29")
wu_zhou_notmutated <- c("P21","P32","P35","P39","P12")
cd <- as.data.frame(colData(sce))
wu_donors_mutated <- cd %>%
  filter(study == "Wu_Zhou_2021",
         grepl(paste(wu_zhou_mutated,collapse = "|"),donor_id),
         disease == "lung adenocarcinoma") %>%
  distinct(donor_id) %>%
  pull(donor_id)
wu_donors_notmutated <- cd %>%
  filter(study == "Wu_Zhou_2021",
         grepl(paste(wu_zhou_notmutated,collapse = "|"),donor_id),
         disease == "lung adenocarcinoma") %>%
  distinct(donor_id) %>%
  pull(donor_id)


# treatment naive patients in the maynard bavona study
naive <- c( "LT_S34","LT_S43","LT_S45","LT_S49","LT_S50","LT_S52","LT_S51","LT_S56","LT_S67",
            "LT_S66","LT_S65","LT_S69","LT_S74")

maynard_donors <- cd %>%
  filter(study == "Maynard_Bivona_2020",
         grepl(paste(naive,collapse = "|"),sample),
         tissue %in% c("lung","lymph node")) %>%
  distinct(donor_id) %>%
  pull(donor_id)

# primary tumor samples in the kim_Lee study
kim <- readxl::read_xlsx("C:/Users/dschulz/data/NSCLC2/data/Kim_Lee_2020_metadata.xlsx", skip = 1)
kim_mutated <- kim %>%
  filter(select == TRUE) %>%
  mutate(EGFR_mutation = ifelse(EGFR != "WT", "mutated", "not mutated")) %>%
  filter(EGFR_mutation == "mutated") %>%
  pull(Samples)
kim_notmutated <- kim %>%
  filter(select == TRUE) %>%
  mutate(EGFR_mutation = ifelse(EGFR != "WT", "mutated", "not mutated")) %>%
  filter(EGFR_mutation == "not mutated") %>%
  pull(Samples)

kim_donors_mutated <- cd %>%
  filter(study == "Kim_Lee_2020",
         grepl(paste(kim_mutated,collapse = "|"),sample)) %>%
  distinct(donor_id) %>%
  pull(donor_id)
kim_donors_notmutated <- cd %>%
  filter(study == "Kim_Lee_2020",
         grepl(paste(kim_notmutated,collapse = "|"),sample)) %>%
  distinct(donor_id) %>%
  pull(donor_id)

# remaining donors
other_donors <- cd %>%
  filter(study %in% c("He_Fan_2021","Laughney_Massague_2020","Maynard_Bivona_2020")) %>%
  distinct(donor_id) %>%
  pull(donor_id)

# merge
all_donors <- c(other_donors,kim_donors_mutated, kim_donors_notmutated,maynard_donors,wu_donors_mutated, wu_donors_notmutated)


# subset sce
cur_sce <- sce[,sce$donor_id %in% all_donors]

# set mutation status
cur_sce[,cur_sce$donor_id %in% kim_donors_mutated]$EGFR_mutation <- "mutated"
cur_sce[,cur_sce$donor_id %in% kim_donors_notmutated]$EGFR_mutation <- "not mutated"
cur_sce[,cur_sce$donor_id %in% wu_donors_mutated]$EGFR_mutation <- "mutated"
cur_sce[,cur_sce$donor_id %in% wu_donors_notmutated]$EGFR_mutation <- "not mutated"

table(cur_sce$donor_id,cur_sce$EGFR_mutation)

# subset sce for only malignant cells
sce_tumor <- cur_sce[,cur_sce$cell_type == "malignant cell"]
table(sce_tumor$donor_id,sce_tumor$EGFR_mutation)


# ── 3. store tumor cell object ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# HDF5Array-backed (on-disk) assays prevent reliable saveRDS.
# After subsetting to EGFR-annotated cells the object is small enough for RAM.

message("\n=== Materialising assays into RAM (dgCMatrix) ===")
for (aname in assayNames(sce_tumor)) {
  message(sprintf("  %s ...", aname))
  assay(sce_tumor, aname, withDimnames = FALSE) <-
    as(assay(sce_tumor, aname), "dgCMatrix")
}
message("All assays now in-memory.")
print(object.size(sce_tumor), units = "Mb")


# ── 4. store CD4 T cell object ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# HDF5Array-backed (on-disk) assays prevent reliable saveRDS.
# After subsetting to EGFR-annotated cells the object is small enough for RAM.

CD4_T_sce <- cur_sce[,cur_sce$cell_type_major == "T cell CD4"]
message("\n=== Materialising assays into RAM (dgCMatrix) ===")
for (aname in assayNames(CD4_T_sce)) {
  message(sprintf("  %s ...", aname))
  assay(CD4_T_sce, aname, withDimnames = FALSE) <-
    as(assay(CD4_T_sce, aname), "dgCMatrix")
}
message("All assays now in-memory.")
print(object.size(CD4_T_sce), units = "Mb")


# ── 5. store CD8 T cell object ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# HDF5Array-backed (on-disk) assays prevent reliable saveRDS.
# After subsetting to EGFR-annotated cells the object is small enough for RAM.

CD8_T_sce <- cur_sce[,cur_sce$cell_type_major == "T cell CD8"]
message("\n=== Materialising assays into RAM (dgCMatrix) ===")
for (aname in assayNames(CD8_T_sce)) {
  message(sprintf("  %s ...", aname))
  assay(CD8_T_sce, aname, withDimnames = FALSE) <-
    as(assay(CD8_T_sce, aname), "dgCMatrix")
}
message("All assays now in-memory.")
print(object.size(CD8_T_sce), units = "Mb")


# ── 5. store regulatory T object ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# HDF5Array-backed (on-disk) assays prevent reliable saveRDS.
# After subsetting to EGFR-annotated cells the object is small enough for RAM.

Treg_sce <- cur_sce[,cur_sce$cell_type_major == "T cell regulatory"]
message("\n=== Materialising assays into RAM (dgCMatrix) ===")
for (aname in assayNames(Treg_sce)) {
  message(sprintf("  %s ...", aname))
  assay(Treg_sce, aname, withDimnames = FALSE) <-
    as(assay(Treg_sce, aname), "dgCMatrix")
}
message("All assays now in-memory.")
print(object.size(Treg_sce), units = "Mb")


# ── 9. Save the processed SCES ────────────────────────────────────────────────

saveRDS(sce_tumor, "C:/Users/dschulz/data/NSCLC2/data/sce_tumor.rds")
saveRDS(CD4_T_sce, "C:/Users/dschulz/data/NSCLC2/data/sce_CD4.rds")
saveRDS(CD8_T_sce, "C:/Users/dschulz/data/NSCLC2/data/sce_CD8.rds")
saveRDS(Treg_sce, "C:/Users/dschulz/data/NSCLC2/data/sce_Treg.rds")
message("Saved EGFR-subset in-memory SCE: ", EGFR_SCE)
message("\n=== EGFR status complete ===")
```
